notes_for_editor: Two sources only. The build date is just 'the 1930s' per NHLR; no exact year was found. The 80 ft height and the district-ranking claim come from one undated reminiscence article written from memory, so treat them as the author's account. The height in facts is converted from 80 ft. Access is not stated in any source, so no access object is set. Condition is as of 2018 only. Do not confuse with the Big Knob on Clinch Mountain in Scott County, Virginia (Eastern US Lookouts big-knob1.html), a different tower; the Eastern US Lookouts Pulaski page (big-knob2.html) has only a register header, so it is not cited. The article's publication date was not found. No photos added: the NHLR 2018 photo has no URL in the cached text.
